logic_errors.issue: Stale Editor-code refusal covers only Assets, but restaging deletes Packages and ProjectSettings as well. An extra embedded-package Editor script is silently deleted rather than refusing the stage without mutation.
logic_errors.reproduction: An independently owned stage containing Packages/com.example.stale/Editor/Surprise.cs and package.json, with a valid ownership marker, was passed to stage_exact({}, fixture, restage=True). The call succeeded, wrote staged-inputs.json, and deleted the stale script/package. The existing Assets/Editor negative test passes, so it does not cover this path.
logic_errors.impact: Violates the requested/documented refuse-without-deletion guarantee and destroys retained stale stage evidence. This reproduction affected only this review's isolated fixture, not the real build stage or accepted outputs.
logic_errors.recommendation: Before writing the marker or removing any copied tree, enumerate all staged compiler-input trees, including embedded/local Packages, and refuse undeclared Editor-capable code. Add a retained embedded-package negative test.

logic_errors.issue: The new probe and the host both have DefaultExecutionOrder(-200), but the probe immediately reads game.Paths and permanently exits when it is null. Paths are initialized in the host's Start, so their equal-order Start callbacks have an undeclared initialization dependency.
logic_errors.reproduction: An exact-source extraction of the probe's initial Start control flow, with explicitly labelled managed doubles, yields no admission when the probe runs before the host; setting Paths afterward does not restart the completed iterator. Host-before-probe admits. Both script metas omit an executionOrder override. This is a source/control-flow reproduction, not a claim that the retained native executions failed.
logic_errors.impact: A valid exact audio/legacy fixture can silently lose the new probe and leave old Phase4 fixture validation active, causing failure/timeouts rather than reliable opt-in execution. All supplied native runs happened to succeed; those runs do not establish an ordering guarantee.
logic_errors.recommendation: Give the probe a distinct order after host initialization and before the other smoke probes, or explicitly wait for/init-check the host before treating null Paths as ordinary startup. Add a regression covering probe-before-host scheduling without enabling ordinary-startup automation.
